title: Improper neutralization of a NUL byte in cPanel allows remote attackers to read any mail account's… (CVE-2026-105475)
description: A vulnerability in cPanel involving improper neutralization of a NUL byte allows remote attackers to read any mail account's calendar and contact data. This flaw can lead to unauthorized disclosure of sensitive user information. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.7. No affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
